name: W013 — Song Vũ Tử Liêm Đao (Cấp S — Animated 2x2 Spritesheet)
prompt_ref: A single standalone 2D game weapon sprite on a pure solid magenta #FF00FF background, following the attached layout_guide_1x1.png safe zone (centered inside 65% of the canvas, zero border clipping). The weapon is W013 'Tử Vũ Liêm Đao' (Death-Dancer's Crimson-Rose Crescent Scythe-Saber, Tier S Epic weapon), placed diagonally from bottom-left (ornate silver thorn pommel at the base of the handle) to top-right (graceful yet lethal swept crescent scythe-saber tip). Design details: an elegant, deadly dark-fantasy bladedancer saber with a sweeping obsidian-and-silver crescent blade etched with glowing crimson filigree runes and a thorny rose-wing guard set with a glowing blood-ruby core; the slender two-grip handle is wrapped in dark velvet-crimson leather and black silver filigree wire for Grip 1 and Grip 2. Draw ONE complete crescent scythe-saber cleanly. Crisp dark outlines, stylized 2D hand-painted game art matching Arcana Five aesthetic, NO character, NO hands, 100% flat solid #FF00FF magenta background.
prompt_anim_2x2: A 2x2 animated weapon spritesheet (4 frames arranged in 2 rows by 2 columns, following the attached layout_guide_2x2.png grid) on a pure solid magenta #FF00FF background. Each of the 4 cells MUST show the EXACT SAME W013 'Tử Vũ Liêm Đao' (Death-Dancer's Crimson-Rose Crescent Scythe-Saber) from the attached reference weapon image at the EXACT same diagonal angle, scale, and position inside each cell's safe zone (zero border clipping), while animating a 4-frame looping crimson death-dance energy aura tightly hugging the blade: Frame 1 (top-left) glowing ruby filigree runes and faint crimson silk-ribbon energy along the blade; Frame 2 (top-right) swirling scarlet spectral rose-petal slashes and rose-gold sparks surging from the ruby guard up the crescent edge; Frame 3 (bottom-left) peak blazing crimson-rose phantom blade aura and razor-wind arcs around the tip; Frame 4 (bottom-right) fading scarlet ribbon wisps cycling smoothly back to Frame 1. Keep the background 100% flat solid #FF00FF magenta with NO grid lines drawn in the final image.
prompt_card: Extreme close-up macro weapon portrait (horizontal rectangular 4:3, 884x632, 100% opaque RGB painting, NO transparent background, NO UI frame). A MATCHED PAIR OF GIANT DEATH-DANCER CRIMSON-ROSE CRESCENT SCYTHE-SABERS (Song Vũ Tử Liêm Đao) identical to the attached reference images MUST FILL 85% OF THE FRAME, crossed diagonally in the immediate foreground with glowing ruby filigree runes, thorny rose-wing guards, and swirling crimson spectral rose-petal energy. Keep the dark-fantasy gothic background softly blurred in blood-moon shadow so the giant twin blades are the sole hero subject in the foreground.
